text:
The plate is a square plate, roughly 22-24 cm across.

Egg whites (scrambled) cover about 50% of the plate. They are piled about 2.5 cm high. The footprint is roughly 250 cm² and the volume about 400 cm³, but with air gaps the effective volume is about 250 cm³. At roughly 0.9 g/cm³ that gives about 220 g.

The sweet potato cubes cover about 12% of the plate, around 60 cm². They are about 2 cm high, so the volume is about 100 cm³. At a density near 0.85 g/cm³ that gives about 90 g.
